sources.model_scope: Capacity expansion and operation with network-constrained UC. Official README documents reserves, storage, demand flexibility, maximum CO2 emissions and optional hydrogen/heat. Pinned Git tree contains 17 bundled case directories (737 files), plus two study-specific case directories. Files include demand, generation, networks, reserves and emission inputs; parameter contents and activation have not been checked.
upstream_caveats: 17 directories are variants and representations, not 17 independent UC benchmark systems. 9n_duckdb is an alternate storage representation.
RTS24 and RTS-GMLC variants overlap known test-system families already collected; keep model-specific inputs but do not count as new underlying grids.
Network-constrained UC does not establish N-1 security; no such claim is made.
Model capability and an Emission CSV do not establish that a finite binding emissions cap or demand response is active in every case.
Case studies are distinct from bundled reference cases and are not in upstream CI, according to case_studies/README.md.
No CSV data parsed, model executed, solver adapter tested, or independent baseline produced.

sources.model_scope: Official example_systems contains 11 example directories and 240 files in the pinned Git tree. Includes three-zone annual examples with thermal, renewable and storage resources, CO2-policy input, CO2 capture, multistage planning, colocated resources, retrofit and a DC-OPF example. Classified as UC-related capacity-expansion research inputs, not a collection of 11 pure integer UC benchmarks.
upstream_caveats: The CO2-capture example README explicitly describes linear clustering UC (UCommit=2); retain this distinction from integer UC.
Policies-slack example intentionally permits penalized constraint violations, including CO2 policy; not a verified hard-cap benchmark.
CO2-capture README labels a cap mass-based while giving gCO2/kWh units; upstream wording is preserved and the cap type must be resolved before conversion.
The 9-bus example is documented as DC OPF; do not label every example directory as a UC problem.
The old GitHub path GenXProject/GenX redirects to GenXProject/GenX.jl. Snapshot uses the current official repository.
Software concept DOI does not identify this pinned dataset snapshot. No CSV parameter values read, optimization run or solver adaptation tested.

collection_summary.counting_note: Source groups are not independent grids, daily scenarios or software libraries. The paired OPTIT Zenodo records are counted as one source family; the two Dispa-SET studies share a model family. openTEPES and GenX are UC-related model/data families; example folders, RTS derivatives, alternate representations and linear-relaxation/OPF examples are not counted as independent integer UC systems. Plan4Res CS3 data and D4.5 documentation are one source group; bibliography-only cross-references and unlicensed alternative toy data are not collected sources.
